exposure: antimicrobial use during labor and delivery
cohort: 1322 parturient women who gave birth in one tertiary, two secondary, and one primary healthcare facility in Cameroon between March 2015 and February 2016.
finding: Referral from another hospital and intrapartum antimicrobial use were independently associated with caesarean delivery, as were several maternal (postpartum hemorrhage, fever, prolonged hospital stay) and fetal (birth asphyxia, respiratory distress, neonatal sepsis) complications.
